title.en: Vinnaiyum Saaduvom (விண்ணையும் சாடுவோம்) — Let us leap even into space

text.en: A butterfly's wing can stir the weather far away; what can a satellite do?

The lesson begins with the idea that a butterfly's wing flap can have an effect elsewhere in the world. It then explains how satellites launched by India's space department have brought remarkable improvements to people's lives.
It describes India's progress in space and inspires students to reach for science. Satellites help in communication, weather forecasting and mapping.
Terms: விண்வெளி (space), செயற்கைக்கோள் (satellite), இஸ்ரோ (ISRO) and அறிவியல் (science).
